title: MRM + SKY130 driver, 53 GBd NRZ
description: Microring modulator driven by a real SKY130 CMOS inverter at 53.125 GBd — the transmitter that examples/mrm_tdec_sky130.py optimizes for OMA - TDEC

notes.title: 53.125 GBd NRZ microring transmitter — what this testbench does
lines: PRBS1 drives a real SKY130 inverter (MP/MN, BSIM4.8 via OSDI).
Its output node vdrv is the ring electrode, so RING1's resonance
swings by dl_dv_pm = 45 pm/V across the 1.8 V rail. LAS1 is parked
-33 pm off the cold resonance, on the slope, so that swing becomes
optical amplitude at the through port (probe popt). PD1 + RL1 turn
it back into a voltage (probe vout).
Open the Eye tab: the UI is 1/baud = 18.8 ps, set from the top-bar
baud field. The eye is visibly ISI-limited, and that is the real
result — the measured electrode edge is ~16 ps 20-80% against an
18.8 ps UI, so at this rate the 130 nm / 1.8 V driver is the
bottleneck, not the ring (whose photon-lifetime f_3dB is 44.5 GHz).
TDEC objectives exist in the Optimize pane -- switch Analysis ->
Optimize and set  objective = omatdec:popt  (OMA - TDEC [dBm],
maximized) or  tdec:popt  (TDEC [dB], minimized). Any optical probe
works; an electrical one is rejected.
But the canvas CANNOT host the full-fidelity co-optimization, and the
arithmetic is worth knowing rather than discovering:
* the reportable _8180 metrics need runs of >=8 identical bits, so
a full PRBS-13 period -- 8191 UI.
* TDEC samples 0.04 UI histogram windows, so it needs ~25 samples/UI.
* 8191 x 25 = 204,775 points, and webapp/simulate.py caps a transient
at 20,000. Ask for more and you silently get 2.4 samples/UI, which
crashes stateye's bathtub fit on an empty CDF.
At the cap you choose between 8191 UI at useless resolution or ~800 UI
with about one 8-run in it -- neither supports _8180.
So the objective here falls back to _4140, and on THIS design that is
not trustworthy either: over a 202 UI record a kappa2 sweep gives
and 0.12 sitting 0.4 dB below both neighbours is not physics. It
survives lowering the assumed receiver noise S (floor -8.52 -> -15.5
dBm, same outlier), so it is the record length, not the saturation
floor. Use the canvas for intuition and sweeps by hand.
THE FULL CO-OPTIMIZATION IS examples/mrm_tdec_sky130.py optimize --
bus gap x lock point x inverter (W_p, W_n, L), scored on full-period
PRBS-13, with the (W,L) grid handled discretely (as SKY130's binned
cards require) and a cheap PRBS-9 surrogate for the inner loop. Hours,
not minutes, and it writes out/mrm_tdec_results.csv.
Also worth turning by hand:
RING1.kappa2  0.076 is critical coupling for this ring; below it
undercoupled (high ER, low OMA), above the reverse.
MP1.w_um / MN1.w_um  driver strength -- deliberately NOT in the
optimize box: a new (W,L) pair compiles a fresh
SKY130 card (41-80 s once, then cached), too slow
for an inner loop. The script does those as a
discrete outer grid.
